objective: Validate and activate a global anti-freeze controller that bounds control-plane liveness without changing frozen scientific semantics.

discovered_pre_activation_defect.defect: When authority drift and call-budget exhaustion coincided, authority diagnosis originally outranked the budget checkpoint barrier.
discovered_pre_activation_defect.risk: Turn could close without the mandatory transactional checkpoint.
discovered_pre_activation_defect.correction: Budget checkpoint barrier now has absolute precedence.

proven_properties: No modeled state emits WAIT, SLEEP, POLL_LOOP, SYNC_HEAVY, RELAUNCH_BLIND, or BROAD_SEARCH.
At call 6 the checkpoint barrier has absolute precedence.
A second consecutive no-evidence-delta observation forces circuit-breaker route switch.
Exact existing outputs are validated before any rerun.
Foreign-runtime non-economic work uses fenced cutover; economic work fails closed.
Known carriers use direct locators before discovery.
Local GitHub network denial switches to exact GitHub connector blob fetch.
Connector safety rejection uses one minimal reference-only retry.
CAS conflict refreshes authority before any write.
Partial outputs are quarantined and never counted as scientific results.
Only one expensive unit may be open.
limits: The layer guarantees bounded non-stalling control flow, not availability of missing external infrastructure.
The exhaustive test covers the modeled control-state space; OS/tool implementations remain additionally governed by existing exactly-once, lease, manifest-first and no-freeze policies.
